name: Atmosphere
description: Weather and room tone to play: wind, rain, sea, fire, vinyl and mains hum, synthesised live. Hold a key to open the texture; its pitch tunes whatever in it is pitched, and more keys layer.

params.name: Type
params.description: Which texture plays: gusting wind, rain drops over hiss, breaking sea waves, a crackling fire, vinyl surface noise or mains hum.

params.name: Density
params.description: How busy the texture is: how often gusts, drops, waves, crackles or clicks arrive. For Hum it adds upper harmonics for more buzz.

params.name: Movement
params.description: How much the texture rises and falls over time, such as the depth of gusts and waves, the flicker of fire or the wobble of a record.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Colour of the texture, from dark and low to bright and airy. The key's pitch leans it as well: low keys are darker.

params.name: Resonance
params.description: Adds a ringing tone at the pitch of the key. Wind narrows into a whistle on that note, and Hum thins towards a pure tone.

params.name: Size
params.description: How far away the texture sounds. Higher settings are darker and more smeared, as if heard from across a room.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the texture takes to fade in when a key is pressed.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the texture takes to fade out after the key is released.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the texture. At full, left and right are independent; at zero it folds to mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Every texture is synthesised from seeded noise, random event trains and oscillators; there are no recordings.
